For the pre-August 2021 model, the risk is deemed probable, so provisions are recognized in the Consolidated Financial Statements, and Glovo had to provide bank guarantees to Spanish courts in 2024 to secure claimed liabilities. For the model since August 2021, the risk is deemed possible but not probable, so it is disclosed as a contingency — a contingent liability of €440 to 770 million for an ongoing investigation. Glovo decided to progressively move to an employment-based rider engagement model in Spain from 2025 to avoid further legal uncertainty, while defending the self-employed status through all available instances.

The commitment fell by 244.8m EUR (304.3m − 59.5m) between the end of 2022 and the end of 2024.

Zalando evolved Zalando Plus in 2024 from a paid membership to a free-to-join, points-based system that rewards customer loyalty for purchases and engagement (e.g., newsletter subscriptions), with points unlocking four benefit levels; it was tested in Spain and expanded to France and Austria, with further rollout planned for 2025 (Group strategy; Foreword; Key intangible resources).

The related year-end accrual is the refund liability recognised for customer receivables already paid where returns are expected, booked in other current financial liabilities (Accounting policies). Vodafone Turkey - 2G extension fee: €120 million for a six-year extension until 30 April 2029 (excluding 18% VAT), paid in advance with a capital injection, with the extension agreement effective as of 27 April 2023.
Turkcell - 2G extension fee: EUR 120 million (plus EUR 21.6 million of value-added taxes), paid in installments: an initial payment of EUR 81.6 million (down payment plus VAT) paid in TRY 1.7 billion during 2023, approximately half of the remaining installments amounting to EUR 31.1 million paid in TRY 1.1 billion in April 2024, with the remaining amount to be paid within a year.

Both agreed to the same EUR 120 million fee, but Vodafone Turkey paid it in advance via a capital injection, whereas Turkcell paid in installments in Turkish Lira, with part of the amount still outstanding.
